gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed diagnosis of WHO grade IV glioblastoma (including variants such as gliosarcoma, giant cell glioblastoma).

candidate_evidence.quote: The sources are impregnated with a layer containing Ra-224 which is well fixated to the surface of the source.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have a time interval ≥4 months between completion of prior radiation and trial registration and have tumor progression per RANO criteria

coder_notes: Intratumoral Ra-224 alpha-emitting brachytherapy seeds registered as a device (radiotherapy), so not listed as an agent. Conditions also list 'Recurrent Gliomas' but eligibility requires WHO grade IV glioblastoma.
